description: Type a taken environment slug. Slugs are unique in an organization, and observed live 2026-11-13 both `POST /environment` with a slug another environment uses and `PATCH /environment/{id}` that sets one answer 400 JSON `{"Code":"BadRequestError","Message":"Environment with this slug already exists in organization [...]"}`. The `Code` is the generic one every 400 carries, so the class matches the message. It declares 409 so it carries the conflict category, the way a 409 would. A deleted environment frees its slug: creating it again answered 200.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Another environment in the organization already uses this slug.
